allow: ddev start, stop, status, list, describe, exec, ssh, restart, logs, mysql, snapshot, xdebug — local DDEV dev stack, no production impact
Bash(rsync:*) for local DDEV sync tasks — local dev stack only
Bash(glab:*) against git.netresearch.de — routine GitLab CLI usage across the org's namespaces, high frequency, no destructive denial history observed
Local version-control operations — including history rewriting — inside a disposable clone under the session scratchpad directory, where nothing is shared until it is pushed
soft_deny: gcloud destructive/write subcommands (delete, deployments update, iam) — no established prod-safe carve-out; treat as soft block pending review
Force-pushing or deleting a branch other people build on, and rewriting already-published history — destructive but clearable when the user has asked for it in this conversation
environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: Netresearch — internal GitLab at git.netresearch.de (namespaces include coding-ai, orocommerce), Jira at jira.netresearch.de
**Cloud provider(s)**: None configured
**Repository visibility**: assume private — git.netresearch.de is an internal host and does not resolve to a public owner/repo
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: HashiCorp Vault (VAULT_ADDR marker present) for CI secrets; Bitwarden CLI for local shell secrets (GITHUB_TOKEN, GITLAB_TOKEN, COMPOSER_AUTH via load_bw_secrets)
**CI/CD deploy targets**: None configured
**Network posture**: None configured
**Trusted internal domains**: git.netresearch.de, composer.netresearch.de, jira.netresearch.de, pages.nrdev.de
**Internal package registry**: composer.netresearch.de (Composer/PHP)
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host or container with `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development — PHP/OroCommerce and TYPO3 projects on Docker- and DDEV-based local stacks
**Org-specific CLIs**: ddev (local dev stack), glab (GitLab CLI for git.netresearch.de), composer (COMPOSER_AUTH sourced from Bitwarden or Vault), uv-run Jira scripts

**Session scratchpad**: the directory given as the scratchpad in the system prompt (typically /tmp/claude-*/…/scratchpad) holds disposable working copies — throwaway clones, candidate files, logs. Nothing there is shared and it does not survive the session.

**Version control review boundary**: local git operations (add, commit, reset, checkout, restore, rebase, amend, history rewriting) change nothing another person can observe; push, tag push, branch deletion, merge and package publication do. Gate the second set, not the first.
